title: Woodland Picnic
kdp_subtitle: Forest Animals Having a Picnic: Fox, Owl, Hedgehog and Raccoon Coloring Pages with Mazes and Puzzles for Kids Ages 4-8
back_lines: A fox, a hedgehog and their forest friends
are sharing snacks. Color the whole picnic!
description:
Join the forest friends for a picnic!

Woodland Picnic is a big 8.5 x 11 coloring and activity book made for kids ages 4-8. Every page has bold, easy-to-color outlines and a fun job to do.

Inside you will find:
  • Foxes, hedgehogs, owls, raccoons, bunnies and bears
  • Mushrooms, berries, apples and cookies in the woods
  • Color-by-number pages with an easy color key
  • Mazes, counting, dot-to-dot, matching and spot-the-difference puzzles
  • Word tracing and a word search for early readers
  • Single-sided pages, so markers will not bleed through
A sweet gift for kids who love animals and the outdoors.
